text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, at a train station a little far
from the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Bright, is that you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there, Creek. ♪ This is quite
the
coincidence. What brings you to a
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was on my way to the academy. But I
missed the
transfer while thinking about
dinner for tonight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well now! I did the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was taken by the wonderful
scenery and
went right by my stop.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh deary... Then, how about we travel
together?
I'm sure we won't miss our
transfer that way. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like a great idea. Shall we
go now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...And then I gave Tamtam a few pats on
the
head, and she gave me the cutest
reaction. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, my dear Ryan is just as cute. I
came across
her shopping for clothes
one time, and...

text_block_list.name: Station Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but we're at the last stop, so
you'll have
to get off...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Th-the last stop?! How can that be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose we were far too
engrossed in our
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek and Mejiro Bright miss their
stop yet
again. Their gentle demeanor
seems to even
affect themselves.
